Retrying after a timeout isn't the same as it "can't time out" — it just gets another 30s shot at the same slow operation. If the original timeout was caused by something that's slow every time (large export, big dataset) rather than a one-off network blip, the retry hits the same wall and times out again, just later.

What was the actual root cause of the original timeout? And is there a cap on retries, or does it keep going indefinitely if every attempt times out?
